blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Complex problems with limited context, such as claims, require a means to obtain additional knowledge necessary for solution reasoning. We propose a multi-agent framework, SMART, to obtain knowledge through capturing the implicit state of participating entities in a problem context. SMART curates the state knowledge as diverse, complementary and solution-salient premises using a variety of LLMs and a structured role-based prompt strategy. Using knowledge from these real-world verified curated premises, SMART's knowledge guided solution reasoning improves validation performance up to 20% on complex scientific claims spanning 3 datasets. We show that grounding premises in real-world knowledge is necessary and improves performance up to 5%.
blocks.zh: 索赔等环境有限的复杂问题,需要获得解决推理所需的额外知识。 我们提议建立一个多代理框架,即SMART,通过掌握参与实体在问题背景下的隐含状态获取知识。 SMART利用各种有限责任和基于作用的结构化快速战略,将国家知识分为多样、互补和有解决方案的前提。 SMART运用这些真实世界中经过验证的馆舍的知识, 指导解析推理, 我们表明,在现实世界的知识中扎根是必需的,并且能提高5%的绩效。

blocks.en: Second, while the vast amount of knowledge that Large Language Models (LLMs) can obtain from pre-training can be impressive Ajith et al. (2024) ; Ge et al. (2023) ; Collins et al. blocks.en: To address these challenges, we propose a framework, SMART, based on a structured role-based prompting method, to obtain salient state knowledge that captures interactions between participating entities as conditional inferences, and uses the knowledge to reason about the solution. Our approach demonstrates how to elicit, verify, and use the state knowledge obtained from participating entities to guide solution-reasoning for the task of claim validation. With SMART, we encourage deeper reasoning using explicit state knowledge obtained from the problem context that is verifiable through external means. In Fig. 1 we outline the process of eliciting and using state knowledge: SMART dynamically identifies entities, concepts, or topics relevant to each claim, and assigns an expert to each entity to obtain deep and connected knowledge between them. To facilitate deeper reasoning, we examine contrastive knowledge: each expert generates contrastive premise pairs that capture opposing views of an entity property, state, constraint, rule, law, etc., in order to critically examine how the state knowledge may (or may not) support the problem. Next, SMART automatically curates these premises, by assessing their validity, identifying their stance alignment to the claim, and selecting a strong premise from each pair that is grounded in established real-world knowledge. Reasoning with these curated premises, SMART assesses the validity of the claim, providing a validation label ( refuted , for Fig. 1 ), a self-rated confidence, and a rationale.
blocks.zh: 为了应对这些挑战,我们提出了一个框架,即SMART,基于一种结构化的基于角色的提示方法,以获取突出的状态知识,将参与实体之间的互动作为有条件的推论,并利用知识来解释解决方案。 我们的方法表明如何获取、核实和利用从参与实体获得的国家知识,为索赔确认工作指导解决方案的合理性。 通过SMART,我们鼓励利用从问题背景下获得的、可以通过外部手段加以核实的明确的国家知识进行更深入的推理。 入法义. 1 我们概述了获取和使用国家知识的过程:SMART动态地确定与每项索赔有关的实体、概念或专题,并为每个实体指派一名专家,以获取彼此之间深层和相互关联的知识。 为了促进更深入的推理,我们研究了对比性知识:每个专家产生对比性的前提对,捕捉对实体财产,状态,约束,法治,法律等的对立观点,以批判性地审查国家知识如何可能(或可能不)支持问题. 其次,SMART通过评估其有效性、确定它们的立场是否符合要求以及从每一对基于既定现实世界知识的前提中选择一个强有力的前提,自动对这些前提进行校正。 由于这些经过整理的前提,SMART评估了索赔的有效性,提供了验证标签(被反驳,图1),自评信心和理由。

blocks.en: We examine SMART’s ability to obtain and combine salient domain knowledge to validate complex scientific contexts from 3 challenging datasets: SFBench Costello et al. (2026) , Scifact Wadden et al. (2020) and Scifact-Open Wadden et al. (2022) . These claims require a variety of domain knowledge and depth of reasoning that SMART can provide. We demonstrate SMART’s usefulness with a variety of small to large, older to newer, open and closed LLMs as agents: Qwen 3 1.7b, 8b & 32b thinking & non-thinking models, Gemma 3 1b, 4b & 12b instruct models, Llama-3.1-Instruct 8b & 70b, GPT-5.4-mini and Claude Haiku 4.5 models. In particular, we find that SMART is especially helpful when the solution depends on knowledge that is not explicit in the problem context and needs to be obtained reliably . It is useful for problems where solution reasoning goes beyond simple verification of searched knowledge and requires sifting through the relatedness of available information. It leads to solutions that are based on deeper reasoning from exploring contrastive views of grounded knowledge minimizing models’ generic reasoning when they lack specific problem knowledge.
blocks.zh: 我们审查SMART从三个具有挑战性的数据集(SF Bench Costello等(2026年)、Scifact Wadden等(2020年)和Scifact-Open Wadden等(2022年))获取和综合突出领域知识的能力,以验证复杂的科学背景。 这些诉求需要SMART能够提供的各种领域知识和推理深度. 我们通过各种小到大、更老到更新、开放和封闭的LLMs作为代理来展示SMART的有用性:Quen 3 1.7b、8b和32b思考和不思考模型、Gemma 3 1b、4b和12b指示模型, Llama-3.1-指令8b & 70b,GPT-5.4-mini和克洛德·海库 4.5型. 特别是,我们发现SMART特别有用,因为解决办法取决于在问题背景中不明确的知识,需要可靠地获得这些知识。 对于解决方案推理超出对所搜索知识的简单核实,需要通过现有信息的关联性进行筛选的问题来说,它是有益的。 它导致了基于更深层次的推理的解决方案,从对基于知识的对比性观点出发,当模型缺乏具体问题知识时,将模型的一般推理降到最低。

blocks.en: Across all methods and datasets, on average, SMART obtained state knowledge improves validation performance (BAccuracy) up to 20% over CoT when providing solution supporting information. Our structured prompting allows explicit control over knowledge used for solution reasoning and allows external verification; knowledge verification improves performance up to 19%. Use of contrastive knowledge minimizes generic reasoning seen with single premises and improves up to 6%. Our contributions are: • we propose a novel framework for verification based solutions employing dynamic context-derived experts for curating verifiable problem-salient knowledge, • we improve solution reasoning using focused problem specific background knowledge to handle incomplete and uncertain information in complex problems, and • we show that our structured role-based prompting method is generic using an extensive set of models with multiple datasets. We will release our code upon publication.

blocks.en: Eliciting and curating relevant knowledge leads to a reliable solution, but requires deeper reasoning with multiple model calls. A benefit is that the curated knowledge is factually verifiable and produces verification based solutions. For systematically obtaining entity state knowledge and curating it for use in the final reasoning, we propose a multi-stage framework, SMART. We show the framework is generic by applying it on a variety of real-world claims which serve as our complex problems. Below, we explain how we obtain, curate and use the state knowledge from the claims.

blocks.en: From the obtained premise pairs, we select true premises salient to the problem. Premises may not be faithful to the problem context due to LLM hallucinations. Even when faithful, refuted scientific claims can lead to untrustworthy premises that do not reflect accepted scientific knowledge. For these reasons, we verify the binary truth of each premise using two different methods: parametric knowledge and websearch, retrieving up to m m documents as evidence. In our running example, both approaches can identify the premise “ JAM-A inhibits the formation of tight junctions in intestinal epithelial cells ” as untrue, though this is not always the case. Verification with websearch allows latest information from new scientific discoveries to factually verify premises; with parametric knowledge, models self-reflect on their knowledge related to the premise.
blocks.zh: 从获得的前提对中,我们选择了问题突出的真正前提。 由于LLM幻觉,房舍可能不忠实于问题的背景。 即使是忠实的,被反驳的科学主张也会导致不可信的前提,不能反映公认的科学知识. 基于这些原因,我们用两种不同的方法验证每个前提的二进制真伪:参数化知识和网络搜索,取回高达m米的文档作为证据. 在我们运行中的例子中,两种方法都可以确定“JAM-A抑制肠道上皮细胞形成紧接口”这一前提是不真实的,尽管并非总是如此。 通过网络搜索进行核查,可以从新的科学发现中获取最新信息,从而对房地进行事实核查;借助参数化知识,模型可自我反映与前提有关的知识。

blocks.en: In the Explore stage, to obtain contrastive premises we use few-shot prompting with 3 examples chosen randomly from outcome causal contrastive states in the CoRE dataset Vallurupalli and Ferraro (2025) . This dataset is based on ROCStories Mostafazadeh et al. (2016) which contain general (non-domain specific) knowledge. These examples demonstrate the general notion of contrasting conditions based on participating entity states; they do not provide domain- or dataset-specific targeting. Since each claim may employ a different number of experts, we obtain n ∗ k = 10 n*k=10 premise pairs for a fair comparison across models and datasets. We use a prompt guideline to encourage generating unique premise pairs and remove occasional duplicate generations (see s 10.3.1 ).

blocks.en: 5 Methodology
blocks.zh: 5. 方法

blocks.en: We use a total of 577 scientific claims which include the newer more complex SFBench dataset (183 claims) and the older complex SciFact (188 claims) & SciFact-Open (206 claims). We combine the latter two as their collection was a single effort. All claims were written and labeled manually; SciFact-Open, considered to have low-bias, used additional automatic methods to substantiate manual labels. SFBench labels are multi-class with values ranging from -2 to + + 2; we convert the -ve labels to refute and + + labels to support . Labels in the SciFact collection are binary but assigned based on an evidence text; each claim is associated with multiple evidence texts and labels. We use claims with a single representative label. Language in these contexts is highly technical & scientific discourse (except for a few covid-related claims with simpler language). The claims are multi-dimensional and require reasoning that integrates several evidence sources from multiple documents. Evidence—whether correct and useful, or incorrect and misguiding—is abundantly available for these claims on the internet, requiring critical and complex reasoning. See Appendix s 10.2 for more claim details.
blocks.zh: 我们总共使用了577项科学主张,其中包括较新的更复杂的SF Bench数据集(183项主张)和较老的SciFact(188项主张)和SciFact-Open(206项主张)。 我们把后两者结合起来,因为两者的合集只是一次努力。 所有索赔都是手工写作并贴上标签的;SciFact-Open,被认为有低比分,使用了额外的自动方法来证实人工标签. SF Bench 标签是多类的,数值从 -2 到 + + + 2不等;我们把 -ve 标签转换为反驳和 + + 标签支持 . SciFact 收藏中的标签是二进制的,但根据一个证据文本指定;每个索赔与多个证据文本和标签有关. 我们使用具有单一代表性标签的债权。 这些背景下的语言是高科技和科学的论述(除了少数带有更简单语言的covid相干主张). 索赔是多维的,需要推理,将多个文件中的若干证据来源结合起来。 证据——无论是正确和有用,还是不正确和误导——在互联网上可以大量获得,需要批判性和复杂性的推理。 详见附录S 10.2。

blocks.en: 5.1 Models:

We use the following open and closed models of varying sizes, both older & newer, from the Llama, Qwen, OpenAI and Anthropic families: Llama-3.1: 8b & 70b Instruct models, Qwen3: 1.7b, 8b & 32b non-thinking models, OpenAI: GPT-5-mini and Anthropic: Claude Haiku 4.5. We also tried models within the Gemma family (Gemma 3: 1b, 4b & 12b), but we found that all models underperformed across the board. For completeness, we provide more information on this in s 10.9 .
blocks.zh: 我们使用来自Llama、Quen、OpenAI和Anthropic家族的以下不同规模的开放和封闭模型,包括较老和较新的模型: Llama-3.1: 8b & 70b (中文(简体) ). 指示模型 Quen3: 1.7b, 8b & 32b 非思考模型, OpenAI:GPT-5-mini和Athropic:  Open: 克劳德·海库 4.5。 我们还尝试了Gemma家族内部的模型(Gemma 3: 1b, 4b & 12b),但我们发现所有模型在整体上都表现不佳. 为了完整起见,我们在第10.9条中提供了这方面的更多资料。

blocks.en: 5.2 Baselines & Evaluation:
blocks.zh: 5.2 基线和评价:

blocks.en: We compare three SMART settings, SMART-PK (using premises that are verified with parametric knowledge), SMART-WS (using with premises verified with web documents) and X-SMART-PK (a cross model approach where models use premises from a good generation model) with two baselines: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) Wei et al. (2022) and a RAG using websearch. We compare with these baselines to show that SMART provides good performance along with providing solution supporting information. We compare with RAG and show that a simple websearch leads to noisy evidence with performance far lower than SMART-PK. With SMART-WS we demonstrate an external method for premise validation and show that even noisy websearch results can improve performance.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了三个SMART设置,即SMART-PK(使用经参数化知识验证的场所)、SMART-WS(使用经网络文件验证的场所)和X-SMART-PK(一个跨模型方法,模型使用来自良好生成模型的场所),有两个基线:思维链(CoT)Wei等人(2022年)和一个使用网络搜索的RAG。 我们与这些基线进行比较,以表明SMART在提供解决方案辅助信息的同时提供良好的性能。 我们与RAG进行比较,并显示简单的网页搜索会导致声音响亮的证据,其性能远低于SMART-PK. 通过SMART-WS,我们演示了一种外部的前提验证方法,并显示即使是吵闹的网络搜索结果也能提高性能.

blocks.en:
We report balanced accuracy of support & refute labels. All results in tables and figures are based on a average of 3 runs; we provide average values and standard deviation.
We report instances where curation yields no premises (as Fallbacks to direct reasoning) and measure premise correctness as the fraction of curated premises that are supported by gold evidence (we verify if the premise is valid using gold evidence in the prompt s 10.6.7 ).

我们报告支持和反驳标签的平衡准确性。 表格和数字中的所有结果均基于平均3个运行;我们提供了平均值和标准差。
我们报告一些情况,即法院没有作出假设(作为直接推理的退缩),并将前提的正确性作为有黄金证据支持的前提的一小部分加以衡量(我们在第10.6.7号提示中用黄金证据核实前提是否有效)。

blocks.en: For SMART’s knowledge guided reasoning, a model should generate both supporting and refuting premises. More importantly, knowledge provided by the curated premises should adequately support a validation label, i.e., lack of knowledge should not be the reason for a refute label. Likewise, we expect CoT rationales to provide adequate support for refute labels. In this section, we explore various aspects of the SMART framework: premise generation, curation and reasoning, as related to performance on our datasets; we demonstrate its usefulness with several experiments and ablations.
blocks.zh: 对于SMART的知识指导推理,模型应产生支持和反驳的前提。 更重要的是,馆舍提供的知识应充分证明一个验证标签,即知识的缺乏不应成为反驳标签的理由。 同样,我们期望竞争委员会的理由为反驳的标签提供充分的支持。 在本节中,我们探索了SMART框架的各个方面:前提生成,图解和推理,与我们数据集上的性能有关;我们通过一些实验和活化来展示它的实用性.

blocks.en: While a lack of information about some claim aspects can lead to a refute label, we notice that LLMs excessively use lack of supporting information as the rationale to refute claims, especially when models lack claim knowledge (or they are unable to leverage it in reasoning). CoT applies this line of reasoning on 23-78% of SciFact claims whereas SMART applies this on 11-46% (see details in Table 3 ), leading to solutions that are not logically sound. While RAG reasoning does not have this exact issue, retrieval of unrelated evidence leads a refute label. To ensure models provide more logically sound solutions, we apply a Refute Filter on rationales to verify whether refute labels are adequately supported. Using GPT-5.6-Sol as an LLM judge, we examine rationales using the prompt s 10.6.14 for all claims with a gold refute label. We filter rationales which lack evidence to ensure our performance comparisons are fair.
blocks.zh: 虽然缺乏关于某些索赔方面的信息会导致一个被反驳的标签,但我们注意到,LLMs过度地利用缺乏佐证信息作为反驳索赔的理由,特别是在模型缺乏索赔知识(或无法在推理中加以利用)的情况下. CoT在23-78%的SciFact索赔中应用了这一推理线,而SMART则在11-46%上应用了这一推理线(详见表3),从而得出了逻辑上不健全的解决方案. 虽然RAG推理没有这个确切的问题,但收回不相干的证据会导致一个反驳的标签. 为了确保模型提供更逻辑上合理的解决方案,我们用一个对原理的Refute Filter来验证被反驳的标签是否得到充分支持. 我们使用GPT-5.6-Sol作为LLM法官,对所有带有金质驳倒标签的索赔,使用10.6.14的提示来审查理由。 我们过滤缺乏证据的理由以确保我们的业绩比较是公平的。

blocks.en: We ensure model reasoning is logical with rationales providing adequate support for refute labels. As seen in Fig. 2 , SMART’s premise guided reasoning works well across all models and datasets, improving up to 20% ; on average 10% on SFBench and 5% on SciFact (averages exclude Llama3 8b due to numerous generation errors).
blocks.zh: 我们保证模型推理合乎逻辑,其理由为反驳的标签提供充分的支持. 如来所见于法相. 2, SMART的前提指导推理在所有模型和数据集中都效果良好,提升了高达20%;SF Bench和Scifact平均分别提升了10%和5%(平均将Llama3 8b排除在外,因为大量生成错误)。

blocks.en: Unsupported refute labels lead to an unsound solution and inflate performance. Smaller models inflate performance more than larger models and SFBench claims inflate performance more than SciFact claims across all methods. Filtering unsupported refute labels reduced this performance inflation; BAccuracy was reduced by 3.5-46.3% for CoT and by 0.6-26.1% for SMART-PK. However, this inflation is smaller for SMART-PK, due to models leveraging premise knowledge in their reasoning (inflation is < < 3% for SciFact; < < 4% for SFBench for models larger than 8b). See more details in Appendix Table 4 .
blocks.zh: 不支持的反驳标签会导致不健全的解决方案和充气性能. 更小的模型充气性能比更大的模型还要多,而SF Bench则声称在各种方法中充气性能比Scifact声称要多. 过滤无支持的反驳标签降低了这种性能通膨;COT的BAccurcy降低了3.5-46.3%,SMART-PK降低了0.6-26.1%. 然而,这种通货膨胀对于SMART-PK来说较小,因为模型在推理中利用了前提知识(通货膨胀对于Scifact来说 < 3%;对于大于8b的模型, < 4%对于SF Bench). 详见附录表4。

blocks.en:
We examine two approaches that add dynamic knowledge to improve SMART: external verification (SMART-WS) and different models for premise generation and reasoning (X-SMART-PK). As seen in Fig. 3 , using different models for premise generation and reasoning improve performance by 4% on SFBench (using GPT-5.4-mini generated premises) and 6.2% on SciFact (using Qwen3 8b generated premises). External verification helps some models but improvement is not consistent due to web-search being noisy. Overall, Llama3.1 70b performance is lower than the smaller Qwen3 32b, due to not generating enough opposing premises and poor curation;
smaller models are worse at curation and meta-reasoning. SMART-WS on SciFact claims lead to guardrails errors due to bait-and-switch websites. We describe and classify all SMART errors (see s 10.10 ) and provide examples in Appendix Table 13 & Table 12 .
blocks.zh:
我们研究了两种增加动态知识以改善SMART的方法:外部验证(SMART-WS)和不同的前提生成和推理模型(X-SMART-PK). 如图3所示,在SF Bench(使用GPT-5.4-mini生成的场地)上,使用不同模式的前提生成和推理提高了4%的性能,在SciFact(使用Qune3 8b生成的场地)上提高了6.2%. 外部核查有助于一些模型,但由于网络搜索的噪音,改进并不一致。 总体而言,Llama3.1 70b的性能低于更小的Qwen3 32b,原因是没有产生足够的相反的场地和糟糕的校训;
更小的模型在美术和元理性上更糟糕。 SCIFact的SMART-WS声称由于诱饵和开关网站导致护栏出错. 我们描述和分类所有SMART错误(见S 10.10),并在附录表13和表12中提供例子。

blocks.en: As seen in Fig. 4 and Appendix Fig. 13 , all models benefit from deeper reasoning with contrastive premises. Not all models implicitly obtain single premises that explore both sides of a claim ( support and refute ). Single premises lead to more rationales that use lack of supporting evidence as the reason for a refute label. Applying the Refute Filter , leads to a performance improvement of up to 4% with contrastive premises over using a single premise; Qwen3 1.7b improves with single premises as it is worse at generating contrastive premises.
blocks.zh: 如图4和附录图13所示,所有模型都从具有对比性前提的更深入推理中受益。 并非所有的模型都隐含地获得探索索赔双方的单一前提(支持和反驳)。 单一的前提导致更多的理由,将缺乏佐证作为反驳标签的理由。 使用校正滤镜,使性能提高至4%,使用对比性场地,而不是使用单一前提;Quen3 1.7b使用单一场地,因为生成对比性场地的情况更糟。

blocks.en: Figure 5: We compare the 5 meta-reasonsers for SciFact claims: M-Majority Voting, R-Reasoning Judge, A-Aggregating Judge, C-Critical Judge and S-Supporting Judge. Reasoning Judge consistently improves performance across models and datasets: by 8% on SFBench and 5% on SciFact on average (See Fig. 9 for SFBench claims and results in Appendix Table 7 ).
blocks.zh: 图5:我们比较了Scifact索赔的5个元理由:M-多数人投票、R-重述法官、A-集中法官、C-关键法官和S-支持法官。 理性法官不断改进各种模型和数据集的业绩:平均在SF Bench上提高8%,在Scifact上提高5%(SF Bench索赔和结果见图9)。

blocks.en: SMART’s premise curation leads to unique but related premises. As seen in Fig. 5 and Appendix Fig. 9 , meta-reasoners, especially SMART’s Reasoning Judge meta-reasoner, improves performance over Majority Voting. Majority Voting, based on independently reasoning with each premise may not capture the collective knowledge in these premises. By interpreting the premises together the Reasoning Judge improves performance up to 8% on both datasets. See results in Appendix Table 7 .
blocks.zh: SMART的前提管理导致了独特的但相关的前提. 如图5和附录图. 9,元理性者,特别是SMART的理性法官元理性者,比多数投票提高了表现. 基于每个前提的独立推理的多数投票可能无法掌握这些前提中的集体知识。 理性法官通过共同解释房地,使两个数据集的绩效提高8%。 见附录表7。

blocks.en: As seen in Fig. 6 and Appendix Fig. 10 premise verification improves performance up to 19% with self-verification using parametric knowledge (SMART-PK), external verification with websearch (SMART-WS) and cross-model verification (X-SMART-PK); averaging across models 2-7% per method with a few exceptions. See results in Appendix Table 8 ).
blocks.zh: 如图6和附录图10所示,通过使用参数化知识(SMART-PK)进行自我核查、使用Web搜索(SMART-WS)进行外部核查以及跨模型核查(X-SMART-PK),10前提核查的性能提高至19%;除少数例外情况外,每种方法平均为2-7%。 见附录表8。

blocks.en: Figure 6: Comparing SMART-NV where no verification is performed) with verification using self (SMART-PK), external knowledge with websearch (SMART-WS), and cross-model (X-SMART-PK) on SciFact claims. Verification improves performance an average by 2-7% across methods for both datasets, with a few exceptions (see SFBench in Fig. 10 ). See results in appendix Table 8 .
blocks.zh: 图6:将SMART-NV(没有进行核查)与使用自我(SMART-PK)进行核查、使用网络搜索的外部知识(SMART-WS)以及SciFact索赔的跨模型(X-SMART-PK)进行比较。 核查使两种数据集的性能平均提高2-7%,只有少数例外(见图10中的SF Bench)。 见附录表8。

blocks.en: 6.1 Premise Quality
blocks.zh: 6.1 精确质量

blocks.en: Improved performance of X-SMART-PK is due to two factors relating to curated premises: salience and the coverage for a given claim context. Salience measures correctness of the premise for the claim whereas coverage addresses the completeness of solution knowledge in all premises.
blocks.zh: X-SMART-PK的性能得到改进,这归因于两个因素,即:突出之处和对某一索赔的涵盖范围。 重要措施是索赔前提的正确性,而涵盖范围则涉及所有房地中解决方案知识的完整性。

blocks.en: Figure 7: Distribution of GPT-5.4-mini curated stances, their alignment with the claim and their confidence ratings for the SciFact-Open dataset. Supporting and opposing premises are required for supporting claims that of the support and refute type respectively.
blocks.zh: 图7:GPT-5.4-mini 配音姿势分布,与主张一致,对SciFact-Open数据集的信心评级. 支持和反驳的索赔分别需要支持和反驳。

blocks.en: We measure the correctness of curated premises as the fraction of premises supported by the gold evidence (per claim average), the percentage of claims where curation does not lead to any premises and the number of supporting and opposing premises in Appendix Table 9 . While these measures provide some general markers, a better indicator for the correctness (and to some extent completeness) of curated premises is the performance; we conclude that premises used in SMART-PK are salient to the claim contexts. Quality of SMART-WS suffers due to not finding salient evidence to curate premises.
blocks.zh: 我们用黄金证据所支持的房舍的分数(每件索赔的平均数)来衡量所管理房舍的正确性、所管理房舍不导致任何房舍的索赔的百分比,以及附录表9中支助和反对房舍的数目。 虽然这些措施提供了一些一般标志,但衡量所管理房舍是否正确(以及在某种程度上是否完整)的更好指标是业绩;我们的结论是,SMART-PK中使用的房舍在索赔方面是突出的。 SMART-WS的质量因没有找到管理房地的显著证据而受到影响。

blocks.en: Orthogonally we examine correctly identified supported and refuted claims. As seen in Fig. 7 the stance of GPT-5.4-mini curated premises aligns with the claim type. Not generating a premise of the correct stance or not curating it (due to an inability to verify its truth or stance) can lead to missed premises that are required for a correct solution.
blocks.zh: 我们正统地审查经证实和反驳的指控。 如图7所示,GPT-5.4小面积房地与索赔类型一致。 如果不能提出正确立场的前提,或不加以纠正(因为无法核实其真实或立场),可能导致错失正确解决办法所需的前提。

blocks.en: Figure 8: We compare the validation performance of SMART-PK with 3 sizes of Qwen and GPT-5.4-mini on SciFact-Open claims using premises generated and curated by one model and solution reasoning with another model. These comparisons show that both Qwen3 8b and GPT-5.4-mini generate good quality premises that other models can curate and use for solution-reasoning.
blocks.zh: 图 8:我们将SMART-PK的验证性能与3个大小的Qwen和GPT-5.4-mini关于SciFact-Open索赔的验证性能进行比较,使用一个模型生成并归为一个模型和解决方案推理与另一个模型. 这些比较表明,Qwen3 8b和GPT-5.4-mini都产生了高质量的前提,其他模型可以对这些前提进行校正并用于解决方案推理.

blocks.en: SMART depends on both a model’s ability to generate both supporting and opposing premises and the ability to curate salient premises through reasoning. We demonstrate that better reasoning can overcome poor premises using 3 sizes of Qwen3 and GPT-5-mini on the SciFact-Open dataset (we use this dataset as labels are considered less-biased). As seen in Fig. 8 all models are worse at reasoning with their own curated premises and better at reasoning with premises curated by Qwen3 8b and GPT-5.4-mini. We leverage this finding for the X-SMART-PK setting. See premise comparisons in Appendix Fig. 14 and examples in Table 10 .
blocks.zh: SMART既取决于模型产生支持和对立房地的能力,也取决于通过推理来管理显著房地的能力。 我们证明,在SciFact-Open数据集上使用3个大小的Qwen3和GPT-5-mini(我们使用这个数据集作为标签被认为不带偏见),可以克服糟糕的前提. 如图8所显示的,所有模特都比用自己配制的场地推理更糟糕,比用由Qune3 8b和GPT-5.4-mini配制的场地推理更糟糕。 我们利用这个发现为 X -SMART -PK设置。 见附录图14的前提比较和表10的例子。

blocks.en: 6.2 Ablations
blocks.zh: 6.2 违约

blocks.en: We examine choices we made in premise generation and curation: a) The number of entities was limited to 5 because across all datasets and models the average number of entities is ≈ \approx 3.5. b) Obtaining 10 premise pairs was to use experts more than once for related premises. c) Curated premises require a meta-reasoner (Abl. 1). d) Using a stronger premise from each pair reduces conflicting knowledge (Abl. 2). e) premise generation involves performance vs. cost decisions for multiple context-derived experts vs. a single and iterative vs. non-iterative (Abl. 3: Context Priming).
blocks.zh: 我们审查我们在前提生成和设计中所作的选择:(a) 实体的数目限于5个,因为在所有数据集和模型中,实体的平均数目是\\\3.5。 (b) 国家 获得10个前提对就是不止一次地利用专家作为相关场所。 (c) 国家 许可的房地需要一名元理由员(Abl.1)。 (d) 国家 使用每一对的更强有力的前提可以减少相互矛盾的知识(Abl.2)。 (e) 前提生成涉及多个背景专家的性能与成本决定,相对于单一和迭代与非迭代(Abl.3:背景定价)。

blocks.en: As seen in Fig. 5 and Appendix Fig. 9 the Reasoning Judge consistently performs the best among 4 other meta-reasoners described in s 10.8 . See results in Appendix Table 7 .
blocks.zh: 如图5和附录图. 9 说明理由的法官一贯在S.10.8所述其他4名元推理者中表现最佳。 见附录表7。

blocks.en: Logically, SMART’s use of a stronger premise to avoid information conflicts is sound, however, models are able to reason with both premises as seen in Appendix Fig. 11 .
blocks.zh: 从逻辑上讲,SMART使用更强有力的前提避免信息冲突是明智的,但是,如附录图11所示,模型能够用两种前提说明理由。

blocks.en: Appendix Fig. 12 compares performance of various premise generation configurations (see Appendix Fig. 15 ) with the SciFact collection. A simple low-resource method is to sample from top-p premise generations (shown as Non-Iter) using a single static (“science”) expert; this increases knowledge redundancy (useful for smaller models) but possible for all models: each API call to the Claude-Haiku-4.5 model provides a single generation and GPT-5.4-mini limits them to 8 (with these models multiple premises can be generated at once, which is not effective for other models). Iterative generation captures fine-grained, related and unique premises, especially, with context-derived experts, improving performance by 2%.
blocks.zh: 附录图 12. 将各种前提生成配置的性能(见附录图15)与SciFact收藏进行比较. 一种简单的低资源方法是使用单一的静态(“科学”)专家从上-p前提代(shown as Non-Iter)中取样;这增加了知识冗余性(对于更小的模型有用),但对所有模型都是可能的:每个API呼叫克洛德-海库-4.5模型提供单一的一代,而GPT-5.4-mini将其限制在8个(这些模型可以一次生成多个前提,这对其他模型没有效果). 活生生的一代捕捉到精细、相关和独特的场所,特别是来自背景的专家,业绩提高了2%。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusions
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We propose a framework, SMART, to curate solution salient knowledge using a structured prompting method with several LLMs. Our multi-stage setup leads to a natural decomposition of a complex problem and allows multiple agents to reason over simpler problem aspects. Using a variety of LLMs on 3 complex claim datasets, we demonstrate that knowledge grounded in real-world evidence can guide reasoning and improve performance. We show external verification with a noisy websearch and leave improvement of search results for future.
blocks.zh: 我们提出一个框架,即SMART,用结构化的催化方法,用几个LLMs来管理解决方案的显著知识。 我们的多阶段设置导致一个复杂问题的自然分解,使多个代理商能够比简单的问题方面更理性. 我们利用3个复杂索赔数据集的各种LLMs,表明以现实世界证据为基础的知识可以指导推理和改进业绩。 我们用吵闹的网络搜索来显示外部核查,并将搜索结果的改进留给未来。

blocks.en: 8 Limitations
blocks.zh: 8 限制

blocks.en: We acknowledge the pre-trained large language models in our experiments can echo biases and mis-information either implicitly or explicitly. Our work does not alleviate or resolve any of these biases knowingly.
blocks.zh: 我们承认,我们实验中经过预先培训的大型语言模型可能暗中或明确地重复偏见和错误信息。 我们的工作没有在知情的情况下减轻或解决这些偏见。

blocks.en:
While we believe our work does not introduce any additional biases, it is likely that our framework may explicate previously hidden implicit biases.
Our premise generation may draw out implicit biases related to the claims and models are likely to hallucinate premises introducing new biases. Our premise verification is likely to suppress these biases especially when an external source such as the web search is used for verifying premises, unless the bias is present in the source documents as well.
blocks.zh:
虽然我们认为我们的工作没有带来任何额外的偏见,但我们的框架可能阐明以前隐含的偏见。
我们这一代人的前提可能提出与权利主张有关的隐含偏见,而模型可能幻灭引入新偏见的前提。 我们的前提核查可能会压制这些偏见,特别是当外部来源,如网络搜索,用于核查房地时,除非源文件中也存在偏见。

blocks.en: We believe that a solution should be based on the knowledge at the time of examining the problem. However, websearch results are not reproducible unless retrieval snapshots or queries are cached. Critical domains will require employing such caching of trusted evidence or maintian domain-specific documents for reproducibility. Results can also change with slight alterations in prompts, however, as long as we are able to obtain and curate premises we can identify what information led to a particular solution.
blocks.zh: 我们认为,解决办法应该以审查该问题时的知识为基础。 然而,除非检索快照或查询被缓存,否则web搜索结果是无法复制的. 关键领域需要使用这种可查取的可信证据或主要领域特定文件来复制。 然而,只要我们能够获得并管理房地,我们就能确定哪些信息导致特定解决办法,结果也会随着迅速变化而改变。

blocks.en: 9 Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 9 道德考虑

blocks.en:
This work analyzes how Large Language Models (LLMs) can be used used for problem-solving. We acknowledge that LLM outputs can reflect biases from pretraining data and we do not make normative claims about models’ solutions. We use publicly available datasets and papers for this work and these datasets did not contain any personally identifiable information. Additionally, our work does not involve human subjects and does not contain any personally identifiable information. While our work attempts to control for brittleness in models’ solution reasoning, it may still produce confident
yet ungrounded solutions for incomplete or under-defined problems.
blocks.zh:
这部作品分析了大语言模型(LLMs)如何可用于解决问题. 我们承认,LLM产出可以反映培训前数据的偏差,我们并不对模型的解决方案提出规范性主张。 我们使用公开的数据集和文件进行这项工作,这些数据集没有任何个人可识别的信息。 此外,我们的工作不涉及人类主体,也不包含任何个人识别信息。 虽然我们的工作试图控制模型的解析推理中的脆性,但它可能仍然产生自信
但是,对于不完整或定义不足的问题,没有找到解决办法。

blocks.en: A Scifact-open claim example: Claim: CENP-B inhibits heterochromatin formation Gold Label: False GPT-5-mini’s direct baseline label and reasoning: True. CENP-B binds alphoid DNA and promotes assembly/maintenance of CENP-A-containing centromeric chromatin and de novo centromere formation; experimental work shows loss of CENP-B impairs CENP-A assembly and can allow heterochromatin features to encroach on centromeric regions, consistent with CENP-B acting to antagonize or inhibit heterochromatin formation at centromeres. SMART (using GPT-5.4-mini as agents) generated final label and reasoning: False. All provided opposing conditions show that CENP-B-containing centromeres bear canonical heterochromatin features (high H3K9me3, low H3K9 demethylase, low transcription, low H3K9ac), which contradicts the claim; published data also link CENP-B with heterochromatin/HP1 recruitment rather than inhibition, so the claim is not supported. SMART Framework Stages for the above claim: For the above final label and reasoning, SMART obtained contrastive premise pairs using GPT-5-mini expert agents. and curated them in the 4 framework stages. Identify (Stage 1): The s 10.6.4 identified the following 5 entities with modifiable states: CENP-B, histone H3K9 methylation, heterochromatin formation, HP1 recruitment to chromatin, centromeric heterochromatin levels Explore (Stage 2): 5 agents are assigned to be experts, each assigned to be an expert one of the 5 entities obtained above, and prompted to generate the following contrastive premise pairs iteratively using s 10.6.5 . (We use an ampersand (&) to separate the two premises in a pair.) 1. Presence of CENP-B at centromeres is associated with low levels of the heterochromatin mark H3K9me3 & Presence of CENP-B at centromeres is associated with high levels of the heterochromatin mark H3K9me3 2. HP1 protein levels at centromeric chromatin are low & HP1 protein levels at centromeric chromatin are high 3. Centromeric chromatin is enriched in the histone variant CENP-A. & Centromeric chromatin is depleted of the histone variant CENP-A. 4. CENP-B physically interacts with the histone methyltransferase SUV39H1 & CENP-B does not physically interact with the histone methyltransferase SUV39H1 5. Centromeric DNA contains CENP-B box sequence motifs. & Centromeric DNA lacks CENP-B box sequence motifs. 6. Centromeric chromatin has high levels of the active chromatin mark H3K4me2. & Centromeric chromatin has low levels of the active chromatin mark H3K4me2. 7. Centromeric chromatin has high levels of H3K9-specific demethylase localized at centromeres. & Centromeric chromatin has low levels of H3K9-specific demethylase localized at centromeres. 8. Centromeric transcription levels are high. & Centromeric transcription levels are low. 9. Centromeric chromatin has high levels of H3K9 acetylation (H3K9ac). & Centromeric chromatin has low levels of H3K9 acetylation (H3K9ac). 10. CENP-B is DNA-binding competent & CENP-B is DNA-binding deficient (to be continued in the next post) Verify & Select (Stage 3): After verifying the truth value (using s 10.6.7 and identifying the stance of premises (using s 10.6.8 ), the following supporting and opposing premises (each of these oppose the claim being “valid”) were curated for use in the final reasoning step. No supporting premises were left as the model was more confident about an opposing premise from each pair and assigned it a higher stance rating. Supporting premises: none Opposing premises: 1. Presence of CENP-B at centromeres is associated with high levels of the heterochromatin mark H3K9me3 Stance Explanation: If CENP-B presence at centromeres correlates with high levels of the heterochromatin mark H3K9me3, that contradicts the claim that CENP-B inhibits heterochromatin formation; however, association does not prove causation and contextual factors could confound the relationship, so confidence is high but not absolute. 2. Centromeric chromatin has low levels of H3K9-specific demethylase localized at centromeres. Stance Explanation: Low levels of H3K9-specific demethylase at centromeres would favor persistence of H3K9 methylation and heterochromatin formation, which contradicts the claim that CENP-B inhibits heterochromatin; although the condition does not mention CENP-B directly, it is inconsistent with an inhibition role, hence opposition with moderately high confidence. 3. Centromeric transcription levels are low. Stance Explanation: Low centromeric transcription is indicative of a heterochromatic, transcriptionally repressed state; this observation contradicts the claim that CENP-B inhibits heterochromatin formation because inhibition of heterochromatin would be expected to raise transcription. While other factors could cause low transcription independent of CENP-B, the condition primarily opposes the claim. 4. Centromeric chromatin has low levels of H3K9 acetylation (H3K9ac). Stance Explanation: Low H3K9 acetylation is a hallmark of heterochromatin (acetylation is associated with active/euchromatin), so centromeric chromatin showing low H3K9ac indicates heterochromatin is present at centromeres and thus contradicts the claim that CENP-B inhibits heterochromatin formation; however, other factors could modulate local chromatin so confidence is not absolute. Infer (Stage 4): Using all the supporting and opposing premises the reasoning judge generated the above provided correct label and reasoning using s 10.6.11 .

blocks.en:
SciFact is a collection of 1409 manual re-writes of citation sentences sampled from well-regarded scientific journals covering basic sciences to clinical medicine. The dataset consists of a dev datasplit (referred to as SciFact ) and a test datasplit (referred to as SciFact-Open ). In SciFact , claim labels were manually identified after verifying each claim against the abstract
of a cited article. Since the labels are based on a single evidence document which is derived from a small corpus of 5K documents there can be label bias. We use the claims where labels are either ‘support’ or ‘contradict’ for a total of 188 claims. We use the abstract on which the label is based as gold evidence for evaluating our premises. To reduce label bias, SciFact-Open obtained more evidence documents, a corpus of 50K documents, using a BM25 search and automatically generated labels from SOTA models using all matched evidence documents. Correlating these automatically generated labels with manually identified labels from the smaller corpus label bias is reduced. A label from each matched evidence document can lead to several labels for a claim which we consolidate to obtain 206 claims that are exclusively supported or refuted (we drop 73 claims that are both supported and refuted). We concatenate all the evidence abstracts for our gold evidence which use for evaluating the quality of premises.

blocks.en: 10.5 Websearch
blocks.zh: 10.5 网络搜索

blocks.en:
We use LangChain’s implementation of DuckDuckGo Search for obtaining search documents. We use each premise as the query to obtain relevant documents without any date restriction. With use the text from the top 3 documents along with the url (we do not scrape data from the url) as searched evidence. Using this information as evidence, we verify the premise’s truth. When no results are returned are returned, the claim the premise cannot be verified and is not used towards final reasoning. When the results are not relevant the premise is likely to be identified as false and will not be used in the final reasoning. When none of the premises are verified to be true, the final solution falls back to the direct reasoning baseline. See Table 9 for an average number of fall-backs (averaged across the 6 datasets).
We don not cache the evidence across claims or across the 3 runs since its main purpose is to verify a condition before selecting it in final reasoning.

我们利用LangChain的DuckDuckGo搜索程序获取搜索文件。 我们用每个前提作为查询,以获得有关文件,而没有任何日期限制。 用前3个文档的文字与url(我们不从url中刮去数据)作为被搜索的证据. 我们用这些资料作为证据, 如果未归还结果,则无法核实有关前提,因此无法用于最后推理。 当结果不相关时,前提可能被确定为虚假,不会被用在最后推理中. 当所有房地都未经核实属实时,最后的解决办法就回到直接推理基线。 6个数据集的平均倒数见表9。

blocks.en: 10.6 Hyperparameters & Premise Diversity
blocks.zh: 10.6 超参数和精确多样性

blocks.en:
For simplicity, we use the same settings for all the models and datasets. We use nucleus sampling to get the top 10% of generations. These are closely related to the claim from which we obtain multiple sufficiently diverse conditions through repeated sampling.
We provide a list of guidelines to follow as part of each prompt, such as, not generating duplicate premise pairs, considering the specificity and credibility of any numbers or percentages, assessing any biases and limitations, etc (see s 10.6.1 ).
With the Llama models, we encourage premise diversity using a temperature of 0.9, but for all other reasoning we use 0.6 a recommended value for Llama models. We use the default temperature for Qwen3, GPT-5.4-mini and Claude models.

blocks.en: Below, we outline research related to the ideas we use in our work.
blocks.zh: 下面我们概述与我们在工作中使用的想法有关的研究。

blocks.en: Causal relationships between implicit states and events have been previously studied using common everyday events Tandon et al. (2020) ; Tandon et al. (2019) ; Ghosh et al. (2023) ; Vallurupalli and Ferraro (2025) . Leveraging their idea of contrastive states, we obtain contrastive premises capturing implicit knowledge in the problem context.
blocks.zh: 此前曾使用常见的日常事件Tandon等(2020年);Tandon等(2019年);Ghosh等(2023年);Valluropalli和Ferraro(2025年)研究了隐性状态与事件之间的因果关系. 我们利用他们的反差状态观念,获得了反差的前提,在问题背景下捕捉到隐含的知识。

blocks.en: Complex reasoning requires models to go beyond exploiting surface level data patterns and reason with knowledge embedded in the context. This requires a model to connect distinct pieces of information and fill-in missing gaps. Zhao et al. (2023) ’s tutorial covers a variety of methods and past works that examined various aspects of complex reasoning. We use some of these methods such as leveraging external knowledge to validate conditions and few-shot exemplars to obtain contrastive states.
blocks.zh: 复杂的推理要求模型超越利用地表水平数据模式和理性,同时将知识嵌入上下文. 这需要一种模式,将不同的信息连接起来,并填补缺失的空白。 赵等(2023年)的教程涵盖了多种方法和过去研究复杂推理的各个方面的著作. 我们使用其中一些方法,例如利用外部知识来验证条件,并用少许的镜头来取出相形见绌的状态.

blocks.en: Techniques such as Self-Correction Welleck et al. (2023) , Self-Refine Madaan et al. (2023) , ReAct Yao et al. (2023b) and Reflexion Shinn et al. (2023) use an iterative approach to improve problem output through incorporating feedback from previous reasoning steps. These methods use a iterative approach to post-hoc correct the solution while we obtain solution-salient knowledge prior to the solution. Techniques such as DiVeRSe Li et al. (2023) , Tree-of-thought Yao et al. (2023a) , Graph-of-thought Besta et al. (2024) examine diverse reasoning paths selecting optimal intermediate solutions. Our reasoning approach selects optimal premises in lieu of intermediate solutions. Multi agent debate frameworks leverage iterative and diverse reasoning paths Du et al. (2024) ; Liang et al. (2024) ; Xiong et al. (2023) , however, Gu et al. (2025) showed that instead of a debate multiple agents can also be leveraged to handle sub-problems. We take inspiration from the latter and decompose obtaining a problem’s implicit state into sub-problems.
blocks.zh: Self-Correction Welleck等人(2023年)、Self-Refine Madaan等人(2023年)、ReAct Yao等人(2023年b)和Reflexion Shinn等人(2023年)等技术采用迭接方法,通过纳入以往推理步骤的反馈来改进问题产出。 这些方法使用迭代方法来修正后热的解决方案,同时我们在解决方案之前获得有解决方案偏差的知识. DiVeRSe Li等技术(2023年),思想之树 Yao等人(2023年a),Graph-of-thought Besta等人(2024年)审查了选择最佳中间解决方案的各种推理途径。 我们的推理方法选择最佳前提,而不是中间解决方案。 多剂辩论框架利用了迭代和多样的推理路径 Du等 (2024) ; Liang等 (2024) ; Xiong等 (2023) 然而,Gu等 (2025) 表明,可以利用多种剂而不是辩论,来处理分问题. 我们从后者中汲取灵感,将一个问题的隐含状态分解为子问题。

blocks.en: The Critical Judge reasons only with the opposing premises playing the role of “the devil’s advocate,” critically considering whether each premise can discredit the claim. The solution is conditioned on opposing premises only, i.e., { y | x , p k ∈ P o ) } \{y|x,p_{k}\in P_{o})\} .

The Supportive Judge reasons with only the supporting premises, considering whether they can support the claim. The solution is conditioned on supporting premises only, i.e., { y | x , p k ∈ P s ) } \{y|x,p_{k}\in P_{s})\} , contrasting the reasoning of the Critical Judge.
10.9 Issues with the Gemma models
blocks.zh: 10.9 与Gemma模式有关的问题

blocks.en: We found that Gemma family models underperformed comparably sized models from Llama and Qwen3. This was mainly because these model were unable to generate a mix of both opposing and supporting premises. Qualitatively, we noticed that Gemma models curate mostly supporting premises which improves the accuracy of valid claims but lowers the accuracy of invalid claims, leading to an overall poorer performance than the CoT baseline. In addition, CoT performance is boosted as lack of supporting evidence as these models use the lack of evidence to refute claims as seen in Table 2 .
blocks.zh: 我们发现Gemma家族模型在Llama和Quen3的可比较尺寸模型上表现不佳. 这主要是因为这些模式不能产生反对和支持两种房地的混合。 从质量上讲,我们注意到Gemma模型主要管理支持性房地,这些房地提高了有效索偿的准确性,但降低了无效索偿的准确性,导致总体业绩比COT基线差。 此外,COT的性能因缺乏佐证而得到加强,因为这些模型利用缺乏证据来反驳表2中的索赔。

blocks.en: Table 2: Gemma Models do not make for good SMART agents for two reasons: a) CoT performance is boosted by refuting claims for which there is no supporting evidence. b) Models are good at generating supporting premises but poor at generating contrastive premises that can lead to refuting evidence. This results in SMART meta-reasoning being overly positive with not having opposing reasons for a claim. As a result, we do not use these models in examining other data besides SciFact. This behavior is also seen to a lesser extent with Llama3.1 70b model.

blocks.en:
Examining errors from both claim sources, we find that incomplete model knowledge relating to a claim leads to errors. Some errors are silent where the model selects the correct label, either due to model positivity or inadequate evidence supporting a refute label . We filter the latter with the Refute Filter but filtering the former positivity errors is not simple as these rationales contain claim knowledge, although, the knowledge is incomplete.)
We roughly classify these errors into the following types:
blocks.zh:
在审查两个索赔来源的错误时,我们发现,与索赔有关的不完整的模型知识会导致错误。 在模型选择正确的标签时,有些错误是沉默的,有的是由于模型的否定性,有的是因为支持被反驳的标签的证据不足. 我们用“校正过滤器”过滤后者,但过滤先前的正态性错误并不简单,因为这些理由包含权利要求知识,尽管知识不完整。 )
我们将这些错误大致分类为以下类型:

blocks.en: a) When models do not have complete knowledge, CoT ignores unknown aspects and supports the claim (Model Positivity) . SMART explores these unknowns with the premise knowledge and either leads to the correct refuted label [Type 1 (these situations are not errors)] , or supports the claim with the same model positivity due to incomplete premise knowledge [Type 3] . There are a few Type 1 and a few Type 3 errors across all models.
blocks.zh: (a) 联合国 当模型没有完全的知识时,CoT忽略了未知的方面,支持主张(Model Positivity). SMART以前提知识探索这些未知数,或者导致正确的被反驳的标签[Type 1(这些情况不是出错)],或者由于前提知识不完全[Type 3],以相同的模型否定性支持这一说法. 在所有型号中都有一些1型和一些3型错误.

blocks.en: b) Models have little to no claim related knowledge, yet, CoT correctly identifies with a refute label, with the rationale citing lack of support for the claim. [Type 2b] . Meanwhile, SMART reasoning either correctly reasons with the premise knowledge, or leads to the incorrect label when the knowledge provided by the premises is incomplete (a lack of opposing conditions either due to a model invalidating them from lack of knowledge or a model not generating them as with Llama3.1 70b are the main reasons for this situation) [Type 2a] . When lacking curated premises, SMART’s Fallback to direct-reasoning leads to the same Type 2b error seen with CoT.
blocks.zh: (b) 模型对索赔知之甚少,甚至没有任何相关知识,然而,CoT正确地用一个被反驳的标签来识别,其理由是缺乏对索赔的支持。 [第2条b款]. 同时,SMART推理要么在前提知情的情况下有正确的理由,要么在前提提供的知识不完整时导致不正确的标签(缺乏对立条件,要么是因为模型因缺乏知识而使其无效,要么是因为模型没有像Llama3.1 70b那样产生这些条件)是造成这种情况的主要原因)[Type 2a]. SMART在缺乏馆舍时,

blocks.en: Even though models identify the correct label, Type 2b are also errors due to not providing adequate support for the label. There are far more of these errors which artificially inflate performance and we handle these with a Refute Filter (see s 6 ). This filtering removes a few correct labels, especially seen with GPT-5.4-mini and Claude-Haiku-4.5, where models correctly cite that there are no known reasons to support the claim. SMART-WS can correct both Types 2a and 2b errors with external evidence helping curate better premises. Models’ performance mainly differs in the number of these errors.
blocks.zh: 即使模型识别出正确的标签,2b型也因为没有为标签提供足够的支持而存在错误. 这些错误中有更多的人为地放大了性能,我们用一个Refute Filter来处理这些错误(见s 6 )。 这种过滤可以去掉一些正确的标签,特别是用GPT-5.4-mini和克洛德-海库-4.5看到,其中模型正确引用了没有已知理由支持这一说法. SMART-WS可以用外部证据纠正2a和2b两种错误,帮助校正更好的前提. 模型的性能主要在这些错误的数量上有所不同.

blocks.en: d) Both CoT and SMART are incorrect due to a lack of knowledge. Similar to a) Model Positivity leads to errors in refuted labels. [Type 3]

blocks.en: Type 1 situations improve SMART performance over CoT; Type 2a & 2b lower the performance for both CoT and SMART after refute filtering; Type 3 lower the performance of both.

blocks.en: Table 3: Comparing the percentage of rationales that lack support for a refute claim that are filtered by the Refute Filter for CoT reasoning, SMART-PK reasoning with contrastive premises and the single premise generation method (SMART-S). These lead to incorrect logical reasoning on 50% of SFBench claims and 40% of SciFact claims (claims with a gold refute ). CoT leads to almost double the errors than SMART on smaller models. Single premise generation leads to more errors on SFBench (double the number than on SciFact) where as the reverse is true for contrastive premises. We discuss these results in s 6 .
blocks.zh: 表3:将无法支持被COT推理的Refute过滤器过滤的被反驳的主张,SMART-PK推理与对比性前提和单一前提生成方法(SMART-S)相比. 这导致了50%的SF Bench索赔和40%的SciFact索赔(带有黄金反驳的索赔)的逻辑推理不正确。 CoT导致在更小的模型上比SMART错误几乎翻了一番. 单前提生成会导致SF Bench上出现更多的出错(比SciFact上的数字多出一倍),反之对于对比性前提是真实的. 我们讨论这些结果 在6。

blocks.en: Table 4: Comparing the balanced accuracy of CoT, RAG and SMART-PK before and after applying the Refute Filter ( refute labels that are not adequately supported are changed to ’unknown’, essentially dropping them from contributing to balanced accuracy). Smaller models either lack or are unable to leverage claim knowledge and select more refute labels, both with CoT and SMART reasoning (the %drop is higher for the smaller models). However, this incorrect performance boost is worse with CoT than SMART (the %drop is higher for CoT than SMART). It is also worse for SFBench’s Material Science knowledge than SciFact’s Biological Science knowledge (the %drop is higher SFBench than SciFact, Llama3 8b model on SciFact is an exception where the model does not generate most rationales). Web search based on a claim is noisy; up to half the RAG refute labels are based on not finding the appropriate evidence. Since RAG performance is lower than CoT, we provide % SMART improvement over CoT in the last column ( SMART-PK improves performance up to 20%. ) We discuss these results in s 6 .
blocks.zh: 表4:比较CoT、RAG和SMART-PK在应用Refute滤镜前后的平衡准确性(未得到充分支持的被反驳的标签被改为 " 未知的 " ,基本上从促进平衡准确性的角度出发)。 更小的模型要么缺乏,要么无法利用声称的知识,并选择更多被反驳的标签,无论是COT还是SMART推理(对于更小的模型,%滴值更高). 然而,这种不正确的性能提振在CoT上比SMART更糟糕(COT的"%滴"比SMART高). SF Bench的材料科学知识也比SciFact的生物科学知识更糟糕(SciFact上的%滴比SciFact高,SciFact上的Llama3 8b模型是模型没有产生大部分理由的例外)。 基于索赔的网络搜索很吵;多达一半的RAG反驳的标签是基于没有找到适当的证据。 由于RAG的性能低于CoT,所以我们在上一栏提供% SMART改进于CoT(SMART-PK提高性能可达20%. ). 我们讨论这些结果 在6。

blocks.en: Table 5: Comparing the balanced accuracy of using Single Vs. Contrastive premises with the SMART framework. We examine performance before and after applying the Refute Filter ( refute labels that are not adequately supported are changed to ’unknown’, essentially dropping them from contributing to balanced accuracy). Single premises often lack necessary claim knowledge that models select refute labels without adequately supporting them. Correcting for this with the Refute Filter shows that contrastive knowledge improves on average across models and datasets by 3%. The smallest model Qwen3 1.7b is worse at obtaining contrastive knowledge, but leads to better performance with single premises. We discuss these results in s 6 .
blocks.zh: 表5:使用单Vs的平衡准确性比较。 校正过滤器应用前后, 我们检查性能( 校正标签没有得到充分支持, 单一的前提往往缺乏必要的主张知识,即模型选择了反驳标签,而没有充分的支持. 用“校正过滤器”纠正这一点表明,不同模型和数据集的对比性知识平均提高了3%。 最小的型号Qwen3 1.7b在获得对比性知识方面更糟糕,但会导致单机场的性能更好. 我们讨论这些结果 在6。

blocks.en: Table 6: Comparing performance (BAccuracy) of SMART-WS and X-SMART-PK with SMART-PK. X-SMART-PK where models use premises from a better generating model: Qwen3 8b for SciFact and GPT-5.4-mini for SFBench. Since SMART-PK does not lead to as much of an artificial performance boost, we compare results without applying the Refute Filter . Performance on SciFact collection of claims improves by a 6.5-14.1%; and up to 8.5% for SFBench claims. We discuss these results and choice of curation model in s 6 .
blocks.zh: 表6:将SMART-WS和X-SMART-PK的性能(BAc精确度)与SMART-PK进行比较. X-SMART-PK 其中的模型使用来自更好生成模型的前提:为SciFact提供Quen3 8b,为SF Bench提供GPT-5.4-mini. 由于SMART-PK并没有导致如此多的人工性能助推,所以我们在不应用Refute Filter的情况下比较结果. SCIFAct 债权的收受率提高了6.5-14.1%;SF Bench债权的收受率高达8.5%. 我们讨论这些结果 和选择 校训模式在第6.

blocks.en: Table 7: Comparing the balanced accuracy of SMART-PK (with Reasoning Judge as meta-reasoner) with 4 other meta-reasoners. We show the advantage of using the Reasoning Judge over Majority Voting in the %Improv. column.
blocks.zh: 表7:将SMART-PK的平衡准确性(将理性法官作为元推理者)与其他4个元推理者进行比较。 我们在% Improv. 一栏中显示使用理性裁判胜过多数投票的好处。

blocks.en: Table 8: Comparing the balanced accuracy of SMART without verification (SMART-NV) with self-verification (SMART-PK), external verification with websearch (SMART-WS) and cross-verification (X-SMART-PK). Improvement with each method is shown in %Improve (the difference in performance between SMART-NV and the method). Verification improves performance on average across models and datasets by by 2-7%. Grounding premises with real-world knowledge provided by websearch improves on average by 4-5% with some exceptions.
blocks.zh: 表8:将SMART(SMART-NV)不需验证的平衡精度与自验证(SMART-PK),以网络搜索(SMART-WS)进行外部验证和交叉验证(X-SMART-PK)进行比较. 每种方法的改进以% Improve 显示(SMART-NV与方法的性能差异). 核查使各模型和数据集的绩效平均提高2-7%。 网上搜索提供的具有现实世界知识的地基平均改善4%-5%,但有一些例外。

blocks.en: Table 9: Comparing inference cost for SMART-PK and SMART-WS in model calls and number of input + + output tokens measured in K tokens (KTok). We report % fallbacks (Fback) to the direct reasoning prompt when there are no curated premises, the quality of curated premises (Qual) and their average numbers per stance (Sup. & Opp.). Both methods require the same # calls since we verify before obtaining stance; these do not include 10 calls that iteratively obtain premises as a single call could potentially be used to obtain all premises for GPT-5.4-mini and Claude-Haiku-4.5. All values are per claim averages. We report NA-Not applicable as the premise quality (Qual) for SFbench claims due to not having textual evidence. Average premise quality by coincidence is the same for both methods, so we report in a single column.
blocks.zh: 表9:模型调用中SMART-PK和SMART-WS的推论成本比较和以K令牌(KTok)计量的输入++输出令牌的数量. 我们报告%回落(Fback)到没有馆舍、馆舍质量(Qual)及其每个姿势的平均数量(Sup. & Opp.)的直接推理提示。 这两种方法都需要同样的#通话,因为我们在获得立场之前就进行核实;其中不包括10个电话,即反复获得房地,作为单一的呼叫,有可能用于获得GPT-5.4-mini和克洛德-海库-4.5的所有房地。 所有价值均为每个索赔平均数。 我们报告说,由于没有文字证据,NA-不适用作为SFbench索赔的前提质量(定性)。 通过巧合获得的平均前提质量对两种方法都是一样的,所以我们在一个一栏中报告.

blocks.en: Figure 14: Distribution of curated premise stances, their alignment with the claim and their confidence ratings for Qwen3 models. Correct identification of refuted claims requires opposing premises and supported claims require supporting premises. Qwen3 1.7b curation leads to few and noisy premises compared to Qwen8b. Qwen3 32 generates too many supporting premises increasing meta-reasoning difficulty. Supporting and opposing premises are required for supporting claims of support and refute labels respectively.
blocks.zh: 图14:被整理的前提姿势分布,与诉求一致,对Qwen3模型的信心评级. 正确识别被反驳的索赔要求有相反的房地,有支持的索赔要求有支持的房地。 与"Qune8b"相比,"Qune3" 1.7b"的修饰导致场地很少而吵闹. Quen3 32 产生了太多的支持性房舍,增加了元理性难度。 支持申请和反驳标签分别需要支持和反对。
